original_answer: The rest of the multi-task learning setup uses a shared-private model architecture: a shared-private feature extractor (built on transformer encoders) encodes the inputs of both tasks, and a selected sharing layer sits on top to selectively capture valuable shared features between the fake news detection and stance detection tasks via gate and attention mechanisms [9][8]. The attention in the selected sharing layer also adopts the transformer encoder architecture [1].

In summary, the contributions of this paper are as follows: • We explore a selected sharing layer relying on gate mechanism and attention mechanism, which can selectively capture valuable shared features between tasks of fake news detection and stance detection for respective tasks. • The transformer encoder is introduced into our model for encoding inputs of both tasks, which enhances the performance of our method by taking advantages of its long-range dependencies and parallelism.
